label: EXISTENCE_NATURALISM_1: ExistenceNaturalism o P w:= ∀ x, o.ExistsAt w x → P x: everything existing…
definition: `ExistenceNaturalism o P w := ∀ x, o.ExistsAt w x → P x`: everything existing at w satisfies the thesis predicate P. With P a spatiotemporal sense: everything that exists is spatiotemporal.
note: Schema in the thesis predicate, so a proponent's own predicate is kept. Attributed to Armstrong only through Murphy's report (claim MURPHY-2021-ARMSTRONG-NATURALIST).
